provenance.extraction: loadCalculatorContext -> calculateOutOfCombatPanel / calculateInCombatPanel; clean source, no instrumentation

inputFacts.skillLevels: explicit effective level 12 (no second mindscape level increase)
inputFacts.selfSwitch: controlled explicit catalog selections; not a simulated combat timeline
inputFacts.claret: initial CD-to-CR conversion and ultimate-period core CR are always active; on additionally selects R2 engine and M4
inputFacts.remielle: two actual anomaly actors (Remielle + Alice); additional ability eligibility satisfied by Alice; initial ATK captured independently in each calculator
inputFacts.roxy: M1/M2 hit states explicitly valid on this target; additional qualifying teammate present; target not imbued, imbuement coverage explicitly zero; external source CR is a declared 50% observation, not an upstream-computed panel

differences.base-precision: 上游整数基础生命/攻击/防御及音擎基础值；Fairy 保留 Nanoka 公式小数，按同一百分比传播。
differences.resource-field: 上游 energyRegen 仪玄 1.2、克拉蕾 1；Fairy 的 spRecover 为 0，不从其他资源推定普通回能。
differences.precision-propagation: 源基础值差经过装备百分比、硫磺石局内百分比、蕾米埃尔 12% 初始攻击共享或仪玄 0.1HP+0.3ATK 转换，再线性传到伤害；逐项验证传播，未放宽容差。
differences.roxy-core-element-scope: 同一显式 50% 来源 CR：上游非风命中也获得普通 CD +0.2/锐暴 +0.1，Fairy 的具名核心仅风伤受益；保留原生差异。
differences.precision-and-roxy-core: 基础精度差与洛克茜非风核心范围差同时传播到暴击/期望伤害；非暴击仍只有基础精度差。

coverageGaps: 上游没有 Roxy 代理人面板入口；她的完整来源配装不可双边验证，50% 是共同显式外部读数。
非风动作可验证 Roxy 核心范围差；不改动作属性来伪造风伤技能，风属性实际动作的完整链路对照留空。
Roxy 额外能力的浸染 18% 在 Fairy 无同义高层静态选项；共同失衡样本声明目标未浸染，原生上游对应条款 coverage=0。
Remielle 核心异化、M1/M2 属性异常/异放条款不属于本文件的动作直伤入口；未将直伤零效果算作这些机制通过，PR4 的异放仍待实施。
